correctness.rationale: The published incidence table supplies all 96 intersecting unordered pairs. On the smooth K3 quartic every line has square −2; the exact Gram construction has characteristic polynomial t^8(t−6)(t+2)^9(t+6)^6 and integral Smith factors 1^10,2^4,6,18. Because the published sum of 24 line classes equals 6H, the ample class is in their rational span; Hodge index makes that span nondegenerate, so matrix nullity is exactly divisor-class dependence. The group therefore has rank16/signature(1,15) and discriminant group (Z/2)^4+Z/6+Z/18. A twelve-line indicator u satisfies Gu=3·1; an explicit integer w has Gw≡0(mod9), sum w=3 and forbids Ga=1. Torsion-free NS and Pic=NS on K3 give the integral divisorial conclusions. The actual included checker ran on this package and passed exact arithmetic checks.

value.rationale: The precise Néron–Severi sublattice generated by the 24-line half, rather than the full known 64-line lattice, is a geometrically canonical object of active interest after the 2026 counterexample to a logarithmic-Chern-slope bound. Rank, signature, discriminant group, and especially the exact order-three obstruction for the natural hyperplane polarization and explicit 12+12 effective cubic divisor splitting give nontrivial integral information not determined by the aggregate 6H identity; these invariants can inform lattice-theoretic descriptions of the distinguished half and its automorphisms. This is a self-contained structural K3 divisor fact, not an arbitrary numerical slice.
